description: Airport traffic data is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics. Details of passenger and aircraft movement data carried on scheduled Regular Public Air Transport services at selected Australian airports. Monthly, Year ended June and Year ended December figures. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics. Its tags are aircraft, airlines, airport, arrivals, aviation. It offers 8 resource(s) in CSV, TXT, XLS. The portal shows 2026-06-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
